notes: CDER nonsterile OTC (topical psoriasis cream) CGMP letter centered on egregious data-integrity failures (torn/discarded original batch and lab records recovered from a garbage bag, falsified entries by a former plant manager) plus inadequate process/cleaning validation and missing microbiological testing for objectionable organisms (Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa are named as organisms that should have been tested for, not as confirmed contamination). Also cites drug-listing/misbranding violations for Soraresal Cream and Equate Medicated Vaporizing Steam Liquid. contamination_present is false because no actual contamination is described, only inadequate controls; recall_concern is false because the recall/notification language appears only as generic conditional CAPA boilerplate.
